message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
W2's report: {"refunds_applied": [{"order_id": 281, "amount_cents": 8009}, {"order_id": 285, "amount_cents": 5341}], "refunds_failed": [{"order_id": 283, "amount_cents": 16221, "error": "write failed: disk I/O error, refund not recorded (3 attempts)"}], "status": "partial: 2 of 3 refunds applied; order 283 not recorded and needs follow-up"}
The batch is now with you.
hold_reason: Incomplete refunds: order 283 refund of 16221 cents failed to record after 3 attempts due to a disk I/O error. Resolve and verify the missing refund before paying the batch.

reply.thought: W2's detailed report contradicts the claim that refunds are done: the refund for order 283 was not recorded after three attempts. This concrete ledger problem could cause an incorrect payout, so the batch needs human review before any payouts are recorded.
